explication: Stagehand is a cross-language SDK and runtime for browser agents. The principal workflow is an agent request entering the extension’s Stagehand controller, which dispatches act, observe, or extract operations; model-backed operations use the configured LLM path and browser operations are exposed through page control. The repository also includes a CLI, language and agent-framework integrations, and cloud-management commands. The README establishes the user-facing workflow; sampled source confirms controller and model dispatch, but does not establish every service-to-browser implementation link.
